properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 725737
Incident Time: 2004-06-19 01:18:00
Nearest City: Thorofare, NJ
Incident Type: PIPELINE
Material: GASOLINE / WATER MIX
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: HARBOR PIPELINE
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 50 gallons
A GASKET FAILED ON A CHECK VALVE HOUSING ON THE FACILITY PROPERTY. THIS GASKET FAILURE WAS REPAIRED AND THE SUBSEQUENT LEAK WAS CONTAINED AND RECOVERED ON THE FACILITY PROPERTY. NEIGHBORING RESIDENTS ADVISED LOCAL EMERGENCY PERSONNEL OF A GASOLINE ODOR COMING FROM THE STORM SEWER. COUNTY OFFICIALS CAME TO THE HARBOR PIPELINE SITE TO INVESTIGATE. IT WAS DISCOVERED THE FACILITY'S OIL WATER SEPARATOR HAD MALFUNCTIONED CAUSING A MIX OF WATER AND GASOLINE TO BE RELEASED INTO A DRAINAGE DITCH ALONG KINGS HWY AND JESSUP RD. RESPONSE PERSONNEL WERE REASSIGNED TO THAT LOCATION TO BEGIN CONTAINMENT AND COLLECTION OF THE RELEASED MATERIAL.
